title: Add tool-call argument scope live coverage
summary: Signed capability docs claim dispatch-time tool.call argument allowlist enforcement. Add real HTTP live coverage that grants a scoped tool.call.echo capability, rejects mismatched arguments before dispatch, and still permits the exact allowed argument object.
expectedFailureModes: A broad tool.call grant hides regressions in arguments.allow scope enforcement.
HTTP tool dispatch accepts mismatched arguments despite a scoped signed capability.
Capability docs claim live scope coverage without an HTTP boundary test.
nextAction: Extend the HTTP tools/call live test with a scoped tool.call.echo grant, a mismatched-argument rejection, an allowed exact-argument call, and docs/status evidence for the live boundary.
